text:
Maria (infra): Proposal: split runtime usage into two streams — `raw_usage_audit` (immutable full events) + `billing_events_v1` (derived/enriched/compacted). Goal: make audits straightforward and keep billing fast. Sketch below.

Alex (platform): +1 on immutability. Quick q: where does enrichment happen? producer-side enrichment vs a central async service?

Taylor (eng): leaning async enrichment. Keep producers dumb -> raw feed is single source of truth. Enrichment service consumes raw, joins user/profile data, emits `billing_events`. Replayable and debug-friendly.

Jordan (billing): Async ok but we need guarantees for invoicing windows. Requirements: idempotency keys, finalization markers, and a canonical way to emit corrections/backfills. Double-charging is a hard no.

Maria (infra): Agreed. Proposed schema additions on raw events: `request_id`, `tenant_id`, `model_version`, `token_counts`, `provenance`, `ingest_ts`. Billing events: add `finalized_at`, `effective_window`, `delta_of_request_id` (nullable). Retention: `raw_usage_audit`=7y (no compaction), `billing_events_v1`=90d + compaction by `request_id`.

Maria (infra): Example config snippet:
```
# Kafka topic hints
raw_usage_audit:
  retention: 7d -> 7y (policy)
  compaction: false
  partitions: 96
billing_events_v1:
  retention: 90d
  compaction: true
  partitions: 192
```

Alex (platform): For ordering & correctness we should partition by `tenant_id` (fallback to `request_id` hash). That keeps per-tenant ordering for windowed joins.

Taylor (eng): Late-arrival handling: enrichment job emits `delta` events when attribution changes (same `request_id` with `delta_of_request_id` filled). Consumers must apply deltas idempotently. We'll include a small reconciliation job that runs at W+1h to generate deltas for window W.

Jordan (billing): SLOs we need: enrichment p95 < 500ms for hosted fast-path (if we choose to support a sync fast path), p95 < 5s for async near-real-time. Reconciliation coverage: >99.99% within 24h. Alert when reconciliation deltas > 0.1% of events for any tenant.

Taylor (eng): Implementation notes:
- Enrichment service keeps a compacted cache of tenant profiles (k-v store) keyed by `tenant_id` for low-latency joins.
- Use `ingest_ts` + event offsets to ensure deterministic ordering for replays.
- Emit `finalize_window` marker events so downstream connectors (billing exporter) can snapshot.

Alex (platform): Connector contract: billing connector should only charge on `finalize_window` for window W and apply any deltas with `delta_type: adjust|revert` before closing invoices. That gives us a single commit point.

Maria (infra): Backfill story: replay raw usage into enrichment service with `replay_mode=true`, generate `delta` outputs. We also keep an append-only audit ledger for regulatory queries.

Jordan (billing): One more ask: add `exposure_tag` for per-feature metering so we can attribute tokens to product features in reports.

Maria (infra): Good call. Will add `exposure_tag` to enrichment outputs.

ingest-bot: Scheduled job `billing-reconcile` queued for 1768007921 (ETA: +1h).

Alex (platform): No blockers from platform. Please add a short section in RFC about operational playbook (hotfix for high-delta rate, compaction reconfigs, partitions rebalance runbook).

Taylor (eng): I'll take the reconciliation implementation PR + test harness (will include synthetic late-arrival scenarios).

Maria (infra): I'll draft RFC + sequence diagram and post WIP. TL;DR: immutable raw feed + async enrichment + reconciliation deltas + finalization marker + tenant partitioning. Sound good?

Jordan (billing): Sounds good. :thumbsup:

Alex (platform): +1. Also add metrics: enrichment latency histogram, delta-rate gauge, finalization-lag.

Taylor (eng): Adding all that to checklist.

Maria (infra): Thanks everyone — I'll ping when RFC is posted.
